name: DeepWork Space
summary:
A place to settle in and focus.

DeepWork Space surrounds your seated workspace with detailed panoramic scenery, from a forest loft and an alpine lounge to a Bali villa, a coastal terrace, a cliff house and a city penthouse at night.

Make it your space:
• Choose six scenic environments or a simple black background.
• Customize your 3D desk with seven finishes, including black, white, wood styles and frosted glass.
• Adjust the viewing direction from the control panel.
• Keep a supported physical keyboard v
